summary.zh: 从调研、大纲到完稿写出一篇博客文章或指南
summary.en: Take a topic from research and outline to a finished blog post

description.zh: 按调研、提纲、成稿、SEO 优化和质量检查的顺序，写完一篇博客文章、教程或指南。适合交来一个选题或一堆零散笔记，需要直接得到可发布全文的时候。研究阶段需要联网查资料。
description.en: Writes a blog post, article or guide in order: research, outline, draft, SEO pass and quality gates. Use it when you hand over a topic or rough notes and want a publishable piece back. Needs web access for research.
